evals.prompt: I want to implement analytics in my Flutter app but I might need to switch from Firebase to Mixpanel later. How should I structure the analytics layer so changing providers doesn't touch business logic?
evals.expected_output: AnalyticsProvider interface in domain. Adapters: FirebaseAnalyticsAdapter, MixpanelAnalyticsAdapter, NoOpAnalyticsAdapter. DI binding AnalyticsProvider→FirebaseAnalyticsAdapter. CompositeAnalyticsAdapter for multi-provider fan-out.

assertions.text: Response creates an AnalyticsProvider abstract interface — not a concrete Firebase class
Response creates at least FirebaseAnalyticsAdapter and NoOpAnalyticsAdapter implementing the interface
Response binds AnalyticsProvider to FirebaseAnalyticsAdapter via DI — changing the provider only requires a DI rebind
Response mentions CompositeAnalyticsAdapter for sending events to multiple providers simultaneously

evals.prompt: How do I set up automatic screen tracking in Flutter when using go_router?
evals.expected_output: AnalyticsRouteObserver registered on GoRouter observers. Uses AnalyticsProvider interface not Firebase SDK directly. Sets screen name on each navigation.

assertions.text: Response uses a GoRouter observer (NavigatorObserver) for automatic screen tracking
Response uses AnalyticsProvider interface (not Firebase SDK directly) in the observer
Response adds the observer to GoRouter observers list

evals.prompt: I need to implement GDPR-compliant analytics — disable collection until the user consents. Also, what are the correct event naming conventions?
evals.expected_output: setAnalyticsCollectionEnabled(false) on init, true after consent. Event names: snake_case, action-oriented (product_viewed not ProductViewed). No color knobs, no screen_shown events.

assertions.text: Response disables analytics collection on initialization and enables it only after user consent
Response uses snake_case event names that are action-oriented (e.g. product_viewed, checkout_started)
Response warns against generic event names like button_clicked or screen_shown — recommends descriptive action-oriented names
